hook.name: ChaplinFeeHook
hook.description: Volatility-based ETH fee hook for ChaplinLauncher pools. Charges dynamic fees (scaling between a configurable base and max bps based on the previous swap's tick movement) on ETH inputs for buys via beforeSwap delta, and on ETH outputs for sells via afterSwap delta. Only exact-input swaps are permitted; exact-output swaps revert.
